text: An Muhammad, lamndo ɓee heeferɓe yedduɓe fii ummital: si tawii ko kamɓe ɓuri saɗtude tagugol, e tiiɗugol ɓalli, e mawnugol cemmbe, diini ɓen ɓe Men tagi ka kammuuli e ka leydi, wonndude e Malaa'ika'en? Men tagirii ɓe kamɓe, loopal narnungal. Ko honno ɓe yeddirta fii ummital, e hoore ko e loopal lo'ungal narnungal ɓe tagiraa?
